items: Restaurant efficiency comes from standardizing everything: clear, repeatable processes, a focus on throughput, and decisions made centrally while each location focuses on execution.
Write detailed SOPs for every core task, with a named role, numbered steps, a checklist version and photos or videos, so new hires become productive fast.
Review your menu by popularity and profitability, keep promoting your stars, reprice or rework low-margin favorites, and remove items that neither sell nor make money.
Put sales, inventory, labor and guest feedback into one source of truth, then pilot changes in a few test locations before rolling them out across your network.
